selection: For each axis, sort eligible case IDs by SHA256(seed + "|select|" + axis + "|" + case_id), then take the first 10.
display_order: Sort selected case IDs by SHA256(seed + "|display|" + case_id), then assign P01 through P30.
sampling_unit: monitor-work candidate record, not necessarily globally unique paper
pool_definition: Retained Task A candidates with agreement in all three accepted base fields and, for subjects, broad relevance; exclude any candidate with any prior human adjudication. Shared uncertain labels remain eligible. No selection using label value, ease, evidence availability or product outcome.
response_mode: Human choices recorded through the local review interface. Written rationales and item-level reading locations were not collected.
reporting: Agreement between final human judgments and the accepted two-model consensus on the sampled candidates.
